purpose: Registry of software-engineering and payment-domain sources used for governance alignment. This is regulatory alignment, not certification.

software_engineering_references.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework SP 800-218
software_engineering_references.applicability: Factory and generated-application secure SDLC practices

software_engineering_references.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Applications
software_engineering_references.applicability: Prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain and model-mediated risks

software_engineering_references.name: SLSA Build Provenance
software_engineering_references.applicability: Generated artifact provenance, hashes, build/run context, and reproducibility evidence
software_engineering_references.current_use: Conceptual alignment with future attestation path

software_engineering_references.name: OpenTelemetry
software_engineering_references.applicability: Future logs, traces, metrics, correlation IDs, run IDs, agent IDs, and workflow step IDs
software_engineering_references.current_use: Design alignment; current project uses structured JSONL audit events

payment_regulatory_references.name: RBI Digital Payment Security Controls Directions, 2021
payment_regulatory_references.applicability: Digital payment security controls, fraud monitoring, risk controls, authentication, security governance
payment_regulatory_references.current_use: Referenced for alignment only; official text must be reviewed before production use

payment_regulatory_references.name: RBI Online Dispute Resolution System for Digital Payments
payment_regulatory_references.applicability: Technology-driven, rule-based, customer-friendly and transparent dispute redressal expectations
payment_regulatory_references.current_use: Alignment for mock dispute-resolution workflow; no official ODR certification claim

payment_regulatory_references.name: RBI Customer Liability in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
payment_regulatory_references.applicability: Customer notification, dispute reporting, unauthorized transaction handling, alerting expectations

payment_regulatory_references.name: NPCI UPI Circulars
payment_regulatory_references.source_type: UPI operating circulars and product circulars
payment_regulatory_references.applicability: UPI scheme circulars, operating changes, dispute/process updates where publicly available
payment_regulatory_references.current_use: Source registry only; project does not claim NPCI certification

payment_regulatory_references.name: PCI DSS v4.0.1
payment_regulatory_references.applicability: Only applicable if cardholder data, card rails, or card-payment scope is introduced
payment_regulatory_references.current_use: Currently out of scope for UPI mock app unless card data is added

privacy_data_references.name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
privacy_data_references.applicability: Personal data processing, minimization, consent/legal basis, data principal rights, retention and protection expectations
privacy_data_references.current_use: Alignment only; synthetic data is used in the current project
